roadmap_item: R3 (R3a four excitation levels + R3b Xe+ - Xe CEX / MEX with the fast-neutral thrust tally) of modern/docs/pic2d-physics-completeness-audit.md section 5; gaps e1 and e4 of section 4.e
status: code-and-tests-complete; shakedown-only; no preregistered run; physics not validated
supersedes: modern/spec/pic2d/pic2d-model-v2.1.json and the v2.0.6 entries of pic2d-model-v2.0.json (every v2.0.x / v2.1 physics, gate, time-step, checkpoint and artifact contract is kept; this file adds ONE selectable physics option, the xenon collision set xe_collision_set_v2, and the ledger / inventory terms it needs). v2.2 is reserved for the SEE stream (R2).
unchanged_from_v2_1: domain, field, time step, Boris push, ion subcycling, fixed-point deposition, bilinear gather, dielectric surface-charge closure, wall-ion recycling, cathode models, gates (v2.0.3 / v2.0.4 / v2.0.6 floors), energy ledger W convention (v2.0.6), momentum ledger keys of v2.0, Poisson solvers (block-Thomas / device-mg), frame recorder, checkpoint binding (the neutral array gains one entry only when the ion MCC is on)
what_changed: e-Xe excitation: the lumped 8.32 eV channel (v1 set, Szabo 2001 convention) is replaced by the four Biagi-v7.1 effective levels 8.315 / 9.447 / 9.917 / 11.7 eV, each with its own threshold = the energy removed per event; the total excitation frequency is the v1 one (the four levels ARE the constituents of the lumped sum: max relative deviation of the summed levels vs the lumped table 0.24 % above 10 eV, 4.9e-23 m2 absolute, interpolation across the sharp onsets only), so a plateau change under this set is attributable to the per-event energy loss (mean loss per event 9.4 eV at 12 eV, 9.8 eV at 20 eV, 10.0-10.1 eV at 50-100 eV vs 8.32 eV).
e-Xe elastic and ionisation tables: byte-identical to the v1 set (same database, same extract bytes, same builder functions).

Xe+ - Xe: two new processes on the ion population, resonant charge exchange (Miller et al. 2002 fit) and momentum transfer (Phelps isotropic component), as a null-collision operator per ion sub-step (dt_i = ion_subcycle x dt) against the local neutral density (0-D inventory scale x plume cone shape) with a Maxwellian atom velocity sampled at the gas temperature; energy argument E = 1/2 M |v_i - v_n|^2.

Ledgers: energy gains the sink ion_neutral_loss_j (W-scaled kinetic energy the ions hand to the neutrals in CEX / MEX); momentum gains pz_ion_collisions (the ions' axial momentum change) plus the fast-neutral terms pz_fast_neutral_exit / pz_fast_neutral_wall / ke_fast_neutral_exit_j; thrust_total_n = flux thrust + cold-gas thrust + fast-neutral exit momentum rate; force_on_thruster_n includes the fast neutrals that hit the body.

Neutral inventory (0-D): sixth ledger term fast_neutral_exit and the sink F in V dn_g/dt = Q_in + R - S - F - c n_g (CEX fast neutrals that leave the channel through the exit aperture); carried only when the ion MCC is on, so v1.3 / v1.4 states and checkpoints are byte-identical.

Identity: MCCConfig.collision_set (name, electron file + payload sha256 + process list with thresholds, ion-neutral file + payload sha256 + processes + grid + speed-threshold factor) enters MCCConfig.to_dict and therefore config_sha256; absent = the legacy set with collisionless ions and an unchanged identity.

Runner: operating_point.collision_set = {name: xe_collision_set_v2, ion_neutral: true | false | {options}} selects the set; load_inputs loads the declared electron file; records_to_arrays carries the new currents, ledger, neutral and momentum scalars (NaN / 0 on older records).

Warp backend: mcc_kernel takes the per-level thresholds as a device array (n_exc = 1 reproduces the v2.0.6 arithmetic bitwise: 0.0 + x, one level, same threshold value), per-level counts through device atomics when n_exc > 1; a fourth RNG stream (ion MCC) appended to the seed table without changing streams 0-2; new kernel module warp_ion_mcc (ion_mcc_kernel) launched after the ion push on ion sub-steps; 16 + 8 new statistics slots.

electron_set.database: Biagi-v7.1 (Magboltz version 7.1, June 2004) on LXCat; export generated 21 May 2023; bytes from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lanl/ThunderBoltz/bdd3013da1954440ed68eec30611d6dad479b6b3/lxcat/assortment.txt (retrieved 2026-09-02T15:35:58Z, re-verified 2026-09-04T16:18:21Z)
electron_set.kinematics: per event: isotropic redirection with the level's threshold removed; level chosen by the null-collision selector's position inside the excitation band split by the per-level frequencies (equivalent to sigma_k / sum sigma_k at the electron's energy)
electron_set.level_choice: the audit's four levels are the Biagi-v7.1 levels; the other e/Xe sets in the same LXCat export are not four-level sets (Biagi/Magboltz-8.9 lineage 33 levels summing ~2x lower above 20 eV; Hayashi 6 partial levels ~1/3; Morgan one lumped total ~1.3x; BSR 47 levels to 80-400 eV) - their summed excitation at 10-300 eV is recorded in the file's provenance; Biagi-v7.1 keeps elastic, excitation and ionisation in one self-consistent swarm-validated database (Bordage et al. 2013, doi:10.1088/0022-3727/46/33/334003)

cases.fast_neutral_exit_channel: born in the channel, reaches the exit plane inside the exit aperture before touching a wall: leaves the channel as thrust-carrying neutral flux; the inventory loses the atom (sink F); its axial momentum -> pz_fast_neutral_exit (thrust_total_n), its kinetic energy -> ke_fast_neutral_exit_j
cases.fast_neutral_exit_plume: born downstream of the exit plane (plume domains): leaves the box; the plume gas is the effusion cone, not the inventory (like ionizations_plume)
cases.fast_neutral_thermal: speed below fast_neutral_speed_threshold_factor x sqrt(k T_g / M) (4 x 138 m/s at 300 K): a thermal atom; stays in the inventory; no ledger term
cases.fast_neutral_wall: dielectric wall, cone, anode, outer box, or an unresolved march (fast_neutral_unresolved, counted): thermalises on the wall and returns to the inventory as a thermal atom (no inventory change); its axial momentum -> pz_fast_neutral_wall (force on the thruster)

fast_neutral_contract.energy_ledger: sources gain - ion_neutral_loss_j = - W sum_events 1/2 M (|v_i|^2 - |v_i'|^2) over CEX and MEX (the energy handed to the neutral population: fast neutrals + MEX recoils - thermal atoms taken up); the particle-side identity dKE = field work + injected - absorbed + born - W sum n_k E_k - ion_neutral_loss closes to round-off (tests, both backends)
fast_neutral_contract.momentum_ledger: dP_plasma = impulse + pz_collisions (electrons) + pz_ion_collisions + born + injected - exit - wall - anode (residual round-off); gas_momentum_rate_n = -pz_ion_collisions - pz_fast_neutral_exit - pz_fast_neutral_wall (thermal atoms taken up, MEX recoils, slow CEX neutrals: stays in the 0-D gas, assumed thermalised with the walls)
fast_neutral_contract.no_double_counting: each atom is tracked once: inventory -> (ionised -> ion particle | effused | CEX fast neutral out); ion particle -> (beam | wall / anode recycled -> inventory); the slow CEX ion is an ordinary ion afterwards
fast_neutral_contract.statement: A CEX event turns an inventory atom into the (slow) ion and the ion into a FAST NEUTRAL that is not a particle of this code. Its fate is decided at the event by a straight-line flight through the cell mask in 0.5 min(dr, dz) steps (the same free-molecular assumption the 0-D inventory makes for thermal atoms), identical arithmetic on both backends.

identity.cross_section_binding: Simulation refuses a cross-section object whose payload hash or process list differs from the declared set, and refuses an undeclared multi-level set; checkpoints keep binding cross_section_sha256 (the electron payload) and config_sha256 (which now carries the ion payload hash)

ion_neutral_set.builder: modern/spec/pic2d/build_xenon_ion_neutral_cross_sections.py (--refresh-source downloaded the pinned WarpX tables 2026-09-04T16:21Z and wrote sources/warpx_phelps_xe_ion_extract.txt sha256 7bab80addce401c7c22959ac7c38944bfedb1f5bf0a6f6d9240309b0c548f085)
ion_neutral_set.cross_check_not_a_process: Phelps' backscatter component (ion_back_scatter.dat sha256 1d47da856088f69d6682c55e00a010883803e83f954e8ea3399d2a3212c2cb3b), the charge-transfer half-sphere of his model: 1.17x (10 eV) to 1.41x (300 eV) the Miller fit - recorded in the file as the data uncertainty of the CEX rate
ion_neutral_set.energy_convention: E = 1/2 M_Xe |v_ion - v_atom|^2 (the ion's kinetic energy for a stationary atom = the laboratory energy of Miller's beam data and of Phelps' compilations; the CM energy of the symmetric pair is E/2; WarpX evaluates its copies at the CM energy - a documented factor-2 difference in the argument worth <= 10 % of sigma on these log-slow curves)
ion_neutral_set.null_collision: nu_max = n_g0 max_E sum_k sigma_k(E) sqrt(2E/M) over the uniform table (0.05 eV steps to 2000 eV); the ceiling is set by the 2000 eV end because sigma_CEX falls only logarithmically; a candidate whose sum_k nu_k exceeds nu_max is counted (ion_mcc_ceiling_violations) and the run fails closed at the next series record; the instantaneous density is the inventory scale x plume shape (device-resident, graph-safe)

processes.kinematics: velocity swap with the sampled thermal atom (= pi backscatter in the CM for equal masses); the atom leaves as a fast neutral with the ion's velocity
processes.source: Miller, Pullins, Levandier, Chiu, Dressler, J. Appl. Phys. 91, 984 (2002), doi:10.1063/1.1426246, Eq. (4): sigma = (87.3 - 13.6 log10 E/eV) A^2, measured 1-300 eV, held at its 0.1 eV value below 0.1 eV, used as the published fit to 2000 eV

processes.kinematics: isotropic redirection of the relative velocity in the centre of mass, both partners keep their CM speeds; the atom's recoil is handed to the 0-D gas
processes.source: Phelps database (www.lxcat.net/Phelps), Xe+ / Xe isotropic elastic component from Piscitelli, Phelps, de Urquijo, Basurto, Pitchford, Phys. Rev. E 68, 046408 (2003), doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.68.046408; bytes from BLAST-WarpX/warpx-data MCC_cross_sections/Xe/ion_scattering.dat @ c42f106f96fe6415c7cc89dd31d1027ff5c8c68e (sha256 5f196141e10b5986b2dc1ad017dd4f3c3d417eb6c17ee1189863e668fce874ab); the rows follow 3.39e-19 E^-1/2 m2 (polarisation form), extended with that power law 750-2000 eV

ion_neutral_set.thermal_atom: Maxwellian at MCCConfig.neutral_temperature_k (the gas / feed temperature; with wall recycling the gas is a two-temperature mixture - the wall-temperature population is not sampled separately: declared simplification)

xe_collision_set_v2.name: xe_collision_set_v2
out_of_scope_here: e2 metastables / stepwise ionisation (0-D metastable pool, xenon-metastable-cross-sections; audit R5b) - not trivial, not attempted
e3 Xe2+ (second ion species; audit R6) - not attempted
spatial neutrals (R5a): the ion MCC reads the 0-D scale x plume shape; the per-particle density hook (density_shape) is the place where a per-node density plugs in
the two-temperature (feed + wall-recycled) atom population in the CEX sampling; sputtering by fast neutrals hitting the wall (their energy is booked, not their sputter yield)

predeclared_expectations.discharge_current: I_d ~ unchanged (< 5 %); the four levels raise the inelastic power ~15 % and lower T_e 3-5 % and S 3-5 % (R3a); CEX / MEX leave I_d, S nearly unchanged (R3b)
predeclared_expectations.energy_ledger: residual-power gate behaviour unchanged (the new sink is booked, so no bias appears); ion_neutral_loss_j positive of order the CEX rate x mean ion energy
predeclared_expectations.iedf_low_energy_population: the exit-plane IEDF gains a low-energy population of 15-30 % of the exit ions (lambda_CEX ~ 62 mm at 3e19 vs 12-24 mm flight paths: 1 - exp(-L/lambda) = 0.18-0.32); early CEX / MEX event rates of the shakedown are to be compared with n_g sigma v N_i
predeclared_expectations.ion_thrust_redistribution: ion beam thrust (pz_exit_ions) DOWN by the exchanged fraction; fast_neutral_thrust_n takes it; total (ion + fast neutral + cold gas) ~ unchanged; anode ion current UP (slow CEX ions); divergence UP (MEX)
predeclared_expectations.ionization_rate: S down 3-5 % (R3a); gross utilisation follows; the n_g fixed point moves with S and with the new sink F (F/S ~ the exchanged fraction of the beam, 15-30 % x the exit fraction)
predeclared_expectations.not_expected: no change of the electron elastic / ionisation rates at fixed T_e (byte-identical tables); no change of the total excitation frequency at fixed EEDF
predeclared_expectations.reference: ss-v4 33 um channel-only plateau 0d228ad2 (I_d 3.80 mA, S 3.60e16 /s, n_g 3.19e19, peak n_e 1.29e18, T_e,peak 5.58 eV, IEDF at the exit plane); all statements are directions and rough magnitudes from the audit (sections 4.e, 5, 9) - a result of the opposite sign is a finding, not a tuning target

xe_collision_set_v2.selection: MCCConfig(..., collision_set=CollisionSetConfig.xe_collision_set_v2(ion_neutral=True | False)) or the protocol block operating_point.collision_set; CollisionSetConfig.from_protocol never reads hashes from the protocol - the named set is loaded from the spec files and its recomputed payload hashes are what enter the identity
